title: CapabilityGrant
description: Answers exactly one question: may this tenant, in this scope, consume this capability? A grant never determines which provider or engine instance serves the request -- that is CapabilityBinding's job. Multiple independent grants for the same tenant/capability/scope may coexist; revoking one source's grant never revokes another source's grant for the same capability.

source_reference.description: Opaque reference to the originating record, e.g. a subscription_id when source=PRODUCT_SUBSCRIPTION. Required whenever source is not PLATFORM_BASELINE.

constraints.description: Platform-level entitlement constraints only (e.g. usage ceiling, allowed markets/channels, trial limits, environment restriction). Constraints SHALL NOT encode domain business-authorization rules -- e.g. "may issue invoices only below a threshold" belongs to the domain engine, not here.
